title: Customer other-products harness pack: repository, environments, seeding, evidence format, gate and composite route are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.5 (DP-05, DP-07, DP-08, DP-11, DP-15, DP-19), R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 8, 10, 11, 14, 15, 16, 29 and 41; legacy RWB-E2-003 sections 3, 12, 13, 15 and 16; _work/msr/plan/ownership.json
section: 3 Preconditions; 11 Data; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: No source read gives the harness repository and the SIT and UAT environments it runs in, the way the run seeds case "RW-2026-000410" and case "RW-2026-000420", borrower "C-0410", account "A-0410", the products "A-0411" with status "ACTIVE" and "A-0412" with status "DELINQUENT", the account number "9900015678" and the role, scope and masking rule rows, the per-run evidence format and its retention, the pass or fail gate that decides the wave 2 acceptance run, or the gateway-bff composite case-record route path and its merge order for the other-products panel. The field IDs of the rwb_access entities (permission, masking_rule), of the rwb_case reference rows and of the rwb_source_data freshness tables are likewise absent from the legacy Data section. The legacy story gives the business values, the states, the rules and the messages only, and ownership.json gives the owners, tables, operations and events only.
evidence: RWB-E2-003 names the synthetic case set, the account number, the masking assumption DL26 and the feature switch rwb.integration.customer-products, but names no harness, no evidence artefact and no gate; Architecture v5 slide 10 describes the gateway merge of rwb-case and rwb-source-data with a response budget and slide 20 makes gateway-bff the only staff entry, without a composite route path or merge order; ownership.json gives no harness table and no harness workflow, and gives rwb-integration the activities deliverFile and receiveFile only.
proposed: The integration lead agrees the harness repository and the SIT and UAT environments, the seeded cases, products, account number and masking rule rows, the per-run evidence format and its retention, and the pass or fail gate with QA at the wave 2 entry check; the platform edge story publishes the gateway-bff composite case-record route path and merge order in RWB-PLT-N001-CON; and the data dictionary owner publishes the field IDs of permission, masking_rule, the rwb_case reference rows and the rwb_source_data freshness tables in the next Logical Data Model version, so the values stay data in the harness pack and never in code.
